title_sq: Hotel me 12 Dhoma dhe ambient per Bar-Restorant, në rrugen kryesore Laprake
description_sq:
Prona kufizohet me rrugën kryesore në një gjatësi totale prej rreth 45 metrash, nga te cilat 14 metra fasade, duke ofruar vizibilitet të lartë. 
Hoteli ka 12 dhoma të gjitha të pajisura me tualete private.
Hoteli ka nje ambient rreth 150 metra ne katin zero i disponueshem ne sherbim te hotelit si bar-restorant apo holl i hotelit ose dyqan duke qene buze rruges kryesore e cila së bashku me ambjentet ndihmese arrin rreth 180 m². Ky kat përfshin edhe 2 tualete.
Kjo prone disponon dhe nje siperfaqe e perdorur si Bar i jashtem rreth 300 m².
Gjithashtu kjo prone ka si avantazh te jashtezakonshem vendndodhjen strategjike te saj per ti mundesuar zhvillim të mëtejshëm në sektorin e hotelerisë dhe shërbimeve.
Hoteli ka një sipërfaqe totale te shfrytezueshme prej 780 m². Per me shume informacion ju ftojme per nje vizite ne prone
title_en: Hotel with 12 rooms and premises for Bar-Restaurant, on the main street of Laprake
description_en: The property borders the main road in a total length of about 45 meters, of which 14 meters of facade, offering high visibility. The hotel has 12 rooms, all equipped with private toilets. The hotel has an area of ​​about 150 meters on the ground floor available for the hotel's service as a bar-restaurant or hotel lobby or shop, being on the edge of the main road, which, together with the auxiliary areas, reaches about 180 m². This floor also includes 2 toilets. This property also has an area used as an outdoor bar of about 300 m². Also, this property has as an exceptional advantage its strategic location to enable further development in the hospitality and services sector. The hotel has a total usable area of ​​780 m². For more information, we invite you to visit the property
